title: Longest Continuous Increasing Subsequence
goal: Find the length of the longest contiguous strictly increasing run.
strategy: A contiguous increasing run ends at the first equality or drop. Remember both the current run and the greatest completed length.

phasePurposes.inspect: A contiguous increasing run ends at the first equality or drop. Remember both the current run and the greatest completed length.
phasePurposes.update: Only adjacent strict increases extend a run.
phasePurposes.done: Only adjacent strict increases extend a run.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
